subject: metaHandler Error and issue with sharing Shiny Dashboard

messages.author: 18d31c1c0daf9cc6
messages.subject: metaHandler Error and issue with sharing Shiny Dashboard
parts:
Hello there. 

I'm working on a shiny app that is utilizing shinyDashboard ui commands. I noticed that when I was opening up my link, I got an error reading: 

ERROR: argument "metaHandler" is missing, with no default.

The app is located on an rstudio server at my local university and a link was provided to me by a systems administrator. From what I understand, the link serves as an index to a folders that contains shiny applications.

The link can be found here:

http://rstudio.morris.umn.edu:4949/ShinyApps/ and the app I'm trying to deploy is called "small.test."

small.test is a very abridged version of the other app in the index called "test.ricky4" - which is also using shinyDashboard. Why I bring up shinyDashboard is because when I don't use shinyDasboard, I don't receive the error above.

For instance, the ui for small.test is:

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
        
dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(
    title = "CST"
  ),
                  
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Home", tabName = "Home"))
  ),
                  
  dashboardBody(
    fluidPage(
      mainPanel(
        p("It can be difficult to find population information from before 1990. Due to many requests from small communities, the Center for Small Towns is providing all population information for every county, town, and township in Minnesota dating back 1900."),                                
        p(br("This information was compiled from the U.S. Census and the American Community Survey. The following people played an enourmous role in gathering this information and developing this website."))
      )        
    )
  )
)


and server is:

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
})


and it generates the metaHandler error. Also, I'm not putting anything into the server because I'm not actually displaying any graphs or figures, I simply wanted to see if I could even display text.


Now, if I change the ui to something that isn't using shinyDashboard commands, it does not generate the error and the app shows up.

This app can be found in the folder "small.test2"

Here is the ui for small.test2:

shinyUI(
  fluidPage(

    mainPanel(
      title = "CST"
    ),
    mainPanel("Home", tabName = "Home"),
    mainPanel(
        p("It can be difficult to find population information from before 1990. Due to many requests from small communities, the Center for Small Towns is providing all population information for every county, town, and township in Minnesota dating back 1900."),                                
        p(br("This information was compiled from the U.S. Census and the American Community Survey. The following people played an enourmous role in gathering this information and developing this website."))
      ) 
  )
)

and the server is the same as above.  


Is there a possibility that using shinyDashboard apps can't be shared if you're not sharing your app via shinyapps.io account or other alternatives? 


Some assistance on this issue would be more than appreciated. 

Thanks,

Ricky.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: metaHandler Error and issue with sharing Shiny Dashboard
parts:
According to this link (by me a few years ago) this can happen when app dirs are moved/deleted: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/292

Can you first try putting an empty file "restart.txt" in the app directory, then reload in your browser and see if that fixes it?

Hi, Joe. 

I put a "restart.txt" file in the app directory and I still got the metaHandler data. 

Here is the link to the app directory again:

http://rstudio.morris.umn.edu:4949/ShinyApps/


Something I noticed on the shinyDashboard stucture page (https://rstudio.github.io/shinydashboard/structure.html) that one can define the header, sidebar, and body. 

So, I decided to make a new test shiny app (small.test3) with this ui:


library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

shinyUI(
  fluidRow(
  header <- dashboardHeader(
    
    title = "CST"
    
    ),
  
  sidebar <- dashboardSidebar(

sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Home", tabName = "Home")
    
    )),

body <- dashboardBody(),
  
  dashboardPage(header, sidebar, body)
  
))


with the server being:

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)


shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  
  
})

This does not generate the metaHandler error, but it does display something peculiar. 


Also, small.test3 was created in the ShinyApps directory, it was not moved from one folder to another.

messages.subject: Re: metaHandler Error and issue with sharing Shiny Dashboard
parts: Looking at the content that your server is providing, I think you have a very old version of Shiny installed, one that isn't compatible with shinydashboard. I'm a little surprised R let you install shinydashboard without updating Shiny as well. Try updating your version of Shiny and see if that helps.
